stations.description: This PC's station ids — one test socket per id (MULTI_STATION.md §1).

station.description: DEPRECATED singular form; read as a one-element `stations` list (MULTI_STATION.md §1).

controller.description: Which controller serves this PC's stations (PYTHON_CONTROLLER.md). `labview` = external LabVIEW engine (default); `python` = the bundled Python controller, auto-started with the app.

simulation.description: DEPRECATED (v1.5.1) and ignored — simulation is per-instrument, set by the Instruments page `simulated` toggle.

config_file.description: Path to an app controller config (instruments, variable maps, step-type packages). The app injects broker + simulation; the app's stations are used if the file lists none. Absent → a minimal generated config.

branding.description: App identity shown in the UI (TEMPLATE.md §1 — rebrand via config, not source).

product.description: The LICENSED unit's Keystation product slug. Framework repo: super_test_app (dev). A derived customer app sets its own app-track slug (e.g. exeliq.acme_eol).

key_map.description: module[:variant] -> entitlement key overrides; default plugin.<module_id>.

github_repo.description: owner/repo whose latest app-track Release carries the .ksupdate + artifact .zip assets.

github_token.description: Read token for a private repo. PREFER the TMF_UPDATE_TOKEN env var per-client; never commit a token here.

channel.description: stable = /releases/latest; beta = newest release incl. prereleases. Default stable.

allow_unverified.description: Install UNSIGNED/dev releases (shown UNTRUSTED) pre-Keystation. Default false — a Keystation deployment only installs a verified manifest.

station_mode.description: online (default): /update/check and /update/download reachable, /update/install-file refused. air_gapped: the reverse. Independent of allow_unverified (that's a trust concern; this is a source concern). Set it explicitly per deployment (DEPLOY_STATION.md).

debug.description: Debug Server sidecar — remote debugging & logging discipline (REMOTE_DEBUG.md §6). Presence of this block makes station.py supervise the sidecar with the station; absent = the sidecar is a manual, loopback-only dev tool.

enabled.description: Master on/off, toggled from Settings → Remote debugging. When true, station.py supervises the sidecar with the station; false/absent = off. Applied on relaunch.

bind_host.description: Explicit interface the sidecar binds. Default 127.0.0.1 (loopback). NEVER 0.0.0.0 (rejected at startup). A non-loopback value requires `token`.

token.description: Opaque static bearer, validated by the sidecar itself with no core call (works when the core is down). REQUIRED for any non-loopback bind_host.

core_url.description: Core base URL for /auth/me and the /diag/level relay (default http://127.0.0.1:8000).

orphan_timeout_s.description: Request→reply deadline before a command is 'stuck' (default 5).

rolling.description: Continuous rolling JSONL sink to disk (survives unattended faults).

retention_days.description: Additional cap; the size cap is authoritative. Default null.

snapshot.description: 30 s pre-trigger buffer of variable VALUES ONLY, flushed on failure. Raw stream/# is never buffered.

include_streams.description: MUST stay false — raw stream/# is never captured.

default_deadband_pct.description: % of a variable's expected range; per-variable override lives in the variable map.

limits.description: Global suppressors + the drop-and-count queue bound.
